[[File:Corrupted lizard icon.png|left]]
The '''corrupted lizard''' is a [[Slayer monsters|Slayer monster]] that resides in the [[Sophanem Slayer Dungeon]]. Level 94 [[Slayer]] is required to damage this monster, and a [[feather of Ma'at]] is required to complete each kill. The cat [[Katarina]] has a chance to spawn upon each successful kill.

Killing a corrupted lizard will award 4.5 [[Reputation (Menaphos)|reputation]] (6.6 on [[slayer assignment|task]]) to the selected faction in [[Menaphos]].
